name: feature-test-sample
description: Template for daily internal feature validation.
globalChecks: Report unexpected navigation, visual glitches, stuck loading, and confusing UX copy.

steps.title: Enter the feature under test
steps.objective: Navigate to the feature entry specified by the product/test case.
steps.action: From the current stable app state, find and open the target feature entry.
steps.expected: The feature landing screen is visible and ready for interaction.

steps.title: Complete feature happy path
steps.action: Perform the core user actions for the feature using the provided test data.
steps.expected: The feature reaches the expected success state, confirmation, or saved result.
riskSignals: Control is visible but not tappable

steps.title: Check one negative or edge state
steps.objective: Look for one high-risk edge from the test case.
steps.action: Trigger the edge state described by QA. If no edge state is supplied, inspect empty/error/slow-network affordances without destructive actions.
steps.expected: The app explains the state clearly and remains recoverable.
